about: D36 (decision log): the paired, interleaved confirmation that is the verdict on "no latency regression", run after the scaling report's regeneration on its 300,000-patient snapshot (the kept D34 build), by tools/benchmark_matcher.py --paired-confirm (protocol paired-interleaved-1.0) into a scratch report and committed here as it was written. The reference is main before D36 (81e812c, extracted from git); the candidate is this tree, whose files the artifact digests bind. The matcher comparison report is not regenerated in D36 (nothing it binds changed), so this file is the latency record for D36. The confirmation queries carry no relative condition, so this measures the path every earlier request takes; execution_store.py is byte-identical in the two codes.
rule: No latency regression: at 14 workers the paired p95 ratio (candidate over reference) is at most 1.05 in every one of the four pairs, and the candidate's own p95 over its 14-worker runs is at most 10 s, with the maximum at most 30 s and query-process memory under 4 GB; the 8-worker figures are reported (committed in fe559ab).

paired_confirmation.order: ABBA: the reference first in even repeats, the candidate first in odd
paired_confirmation.note: Each pair is the reference code and the candidate code run back to back, each in a fresh process with a warm pool, on the same snapshot and queries; the reference runs first in even repeats and second in odd ones (ABBA). Ratios are candidate over reference: below 1 means the candidate is faster. "total" is the sum of the per-query match seconds of one run. The absolute target is judged on the candidate's own runs in this session. The pairing cancels drift that is slow against the length of a pair (minutes); it does not cancel noise within a run, nor a difference that only one order shows (compare the reference-first and candidate-first pairs).

limitations: one machine and one session; synthetic data replicated beyond 10,000 patients; the p95 of 30 queries is the second-slowest query; the paired protocol cancels slow drift, not noise inside a run
